name: Saving Songburg
storyline:
The peaceful town of Songburg is under siege. A gang of interdimensional art thieves known only as the Dream Stealers have invaded, stealing the music, color, and creativity from everything they touch.

Only one hero can stop them: Automavoz — an adorable robot companion to the Wizard of Voz. Armed with musical abilities, quick reflexes, and an unshakeable spirit, Automavoz must journey through Songburg's vibrant worlds to recover what was stolen and restore harmony to the town.

Help the Wizard. Stop the Thieves. Save the Music.
summary: Saving Songburg is a 3D third-person action-adventure platformer, set in a whimsical Steampunk world. Help the robot Automavoz save the town of Songburg from the interdimensional gang of art thieves known as the Dream Stealers!
